verdict.rationale: Tailscale is a network management platform with many devices, users and ACLs, so bulk operations are a fair question. The evidence pack never documents a bulk-action capability, such as selecting and acting on many devices or users at once. Infrastructure-as-code providers, policy-file editing, cloud-init installs and the CLI are adjacent automation or building blocks, not a documented bulk-operations feature, so they earn no credit here.
